paragraphs.text: Snail is a creature type , used on cards that depict a species of shelled gastropods. The type first appeared in The Lost Caverns of Ixalan with Skullcap Snail and it made its first appearance as a token in Bloomburrow .
Ixalan is home to a type of fungus snail called the Skullcap Snail. They appear to use the skulls of dead animals as their shell while also having small mushrooms growing out of their body.
